data.hypothesis: Density is called repeatedly during raymarching and transmittance. Replacing its eight D calls with six shared clamps and reusable flat row/plane offsets may reduce redundant integer/address work without a copied or precomputed volume. Coordinate conversion, inclusive Inside test, per-neighbor clamping, and interpolation order remain unchanged; the compiler may already eliminate some redundancy, so only isolated controller measurements can establish benefit.
data.notes: This is a single no-copy sampler variant; it deliberately does not add a halo/clamp volume or alter coordinate factors. The supplied baseline is correct at 5.2566 s mean, but no candidate tolerance or timing result is available yet. Controller validation and isolated timing are still required.
transformations: Remplacer les huit appels D dans Density par le clamp explicite des deux indices voisins par axe, puis réutiliser les offsets plats de lignes et de plans pour les huit lectures.
